justification: `javaparser-symbol-solver-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/resolution/typeinference/ControlFlowLogic.java` is a 333-line class with 6 public methods and 4 private helpers, and it bundles several distinct responsibilities: break/continue target handling, statement reachability, and normal-completion analysis. The file also contains large embedded visitors for different statement kinds plus multiple unimplemented stubs (`breakTarget`, `contains`, `containedTryStmts`, `isReachableBecauseOfPosition`, and `visit(LabeledStmt)`), indicating a partially decomposed utility rather than a tightly cohesive class.
